# Hitesh Rana

> Hitesh Rana is a backend engineer at Mercari working on fraud and risk systems. His portfolio covers distributed systems, database internals, Go developer tools, open-source projects, and engineering contributions.

This is a single-page personal portfolio. The work history and outcomes below are self-reported professional information, not independent benchmarks. The website is the source for the accompanying Markdown snapshot.
